coverage: Gaps indicate missing data; bucket precision is shown below.
summary: Each row summarizes one application in a five-minute window. CPU is an average, memory is a peak, and disk values are totals. Each window retains the union of the CPU, memory, and disk top ten.
empty: No data in this time range.
appRetention: Application summaries are retained for seven days.
recordingError: Recording is unavailable. Check the application’s recording status.
